title: Policy canonicalizer + constraint linter for multi-dim routing (regions, tiers, fallbacks)
creator: Aisha Khatri
description:
Problem: Current routing rule interpreter accepts multiple overlapping DSL constructs for region selection, tier routing, and fallback model variants. This causes inconsistent behavior across hosted/dedicated/private deployments and makes validation tests flaky. We need a refactor that emits a single canonical intermediate representation (CIR) from the DSL, performs constraint solving/linting (region availability, tier compatibility, model variant fallbacks), and surfaces actionable errors or auto-fixes.

Scope:
- Implement a canonicalizer that normalizes routing rules (region selectors, tier filters, model variant chains) into a well-defined CIR.
- Add a constraint linter that validates CIR against: available regions per account, supported model variants per runtime, tier routing rules (enterprise/dedicated/hosted), and fallback compatibility matrix.
- Provide safe auto-fix suggestions and a migration tool to transform legacy rules to CIR-compatible format when possible.
- Expose clear error messages to Console and fail-fast on invalid configs during deploy.
- Add unit/integration tests and CI lint job; create a canary rollout for runtime-2.3.

Non-goals: full policy evaluation runtime rewrite (we're only adding canonicalization + validation layer and small interpreter adapter).
technical_decisions: Introduce a single canonical IR (CIR) with explicit fields: selectors.regions[], selectors.tiers[], routes[] with fallbacks[]. CIR is JSON-serializable and versioned (cir_v1).

Perform constraint validation in two phases: static (schema + availability checks) and dynamic (capacity-aware compatibility against runtime metadata). Static validation runs in CI + Console; dynamic validation runs at deploy time and can be skipped with --force.

Compatibility matrix: define minimal runtime features required by a fallback variant; validators will compare model_variant->required_features against cluster feature flags during deploy and surface a detailed mismatch report.

Auto-fix rules implemented as deterministic rewrites (e.g., convert 'region: eu' -> selectors.regions: ['eu-west-1','eu-central-1'] using account-region-mapping), optional and gated behind migration flag.
Keep existing policy interpreter as an adapter that consumes CIR to minimize runtime risk; plan to deprecate legacy paths after 2 cycles of stable telemetry.
Expose lint results to Console with actionable links (PR templates, migration guide) and to API as structured warnings/errors for infra automation.
acceptance_criteria: CIR schema (cir_v1.json) checked into repo and validated by new schema linter job (CI).
New linter identifies at least three classes of misconfigurations with explanatory messages: missing-region-mapping, incompatible-fallback, tier-violation; unit tests for each case.
Migration tool can auto-convert >90% of sampled legacy rules from customer cluster (internal dataset) without manual edits; remaining cases produce clear migration hints.
Canary rollout on runtime-2.3 for 5% of traffic with fallback to legacy interpreter on error, observed for 72 hours with telemetry showing no increase in 5xxs or SLA violations.
Console surfaces linter errors inline on policy edit and provides a one-click 'suggested fix' that opens a PR/migration change.
comments: 2025-02-19 - Aisha Khatri: Initial design review completed. Agreed on two-phase validation. Miguel to prototype CIR shape and runbook for migration.
2025-02-22 - Miguel Santos: Prototype canonicalizer implemented; early tests show 15% reduction in ambiguous route matches for test corpus. Added sample cir_v1.json to /specs.
2025-02-25 - Priya Menon (PM): Verified acceptance criteria align with product goals. Requested inline Console UX patterns for error messages.
2025-02-27 - Security Review (James Li): flagged requirement to ensure CIR does not leak internal region mapping; added guideline to redact account-specific mappings from public logs.
2025-02-28 - Miguel Santos: Opened PR #4823 for canonicalizer; blocking on integration tests against runtime metadata service (ENG-9531 dependency).
2025-03-01 - QA (Lena Grey): Added test cases for fallback chain depth >3; found an edge-case where circular fallback references were not detected — added to risks.
risks: Auto-fixes could silently change customer intent if region mappings are incorrect; migration tool must require review and produce diffs.
Mismatch between static CI validation and dynamic deploy-time validation could lead to surprise failures during canary; need synchronized metadata snapshots.
Circular fallback chains can cause infinite evaluation loops if not detected; must add a cycle-detection step in canonicalizer.

Implement dynamic compatibility checks against runtime feature flags (ENG-9531 owners) and add integration tests (3d).
Build Console UI hooks for inline linter messages and suggested-fix workflow (Design: DES-2141 collaboration).
Schedule a canary rollout for runtime-2.3 (SRE coordination) and create monitoring dashboard for regression signals.
